SELECT rh.material_receipt_id AS materialReceiptId, rd.material_receipt_detail_id AS materialReceiptDetailId, rh.receipt_no AS receiptNo, rh.receipt_dt AS receiptDt, c.customer_name AS supplierName, u.user_nm AS receiverName, CASE WHEN rh.use_at = 'Y' THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'CANCELED' END AS status, rh.tax_type AS taxType, tci.item_nm AS taxTypeName, rh.vat_included_at AS vatIncludedAt, rh.supply_amt AS headerSupplyAmt, rh.vat_amt AS headerVatAmt, rh.total_amt AS headerTotalAmt, rh.remark AS headerRemark, rd.line_no AS lineNo, rd.arrival_no AS arrivalNo, ad.material_arrival_id AS materialArrivalId, (ah.use_at = 'Y') AS arrivalLinked, rd.inspection_no AS inspectionNo, rd.closing_month AS closingMonth, oh.order_no AS orderNo, m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, m.material_spec AS materialSpec, m.unit AS unit, rd.receipt_qty AS receiptQty, rd.unit_price AS unitPrice, rd.supply_amt AS supplyAmt, rd.vat_amt AS vatAmt, rd.total_amt AS totalAmt, w.warehouse_name AS warehouseName, rd.manufacture_dt AS manufactureDt, rd.expire_dt AS expireDt, rd.lot_no AS lotNo, rd.remark AS remark, cu.user_nm AS createdByName FROM tb_material_receipt_hd rh JOIN tb_material_receipt_dt rd ON rd.material_receipt_id = rh.material_receipt_id AND rd.tenant_id = rh.tenant_id JOIN tb_purchase_order_dt od ON od.purchase_order_detail_id = rd.purchase_order_detail_id JOIN tb_purchase_order_hd oh ON oh.purchase_order_id = od.purchase_order_id AND oh.tenant_id = od.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_material_arrival_dt ad ON ad.material_arrival_detail_id = rd.material_arrival_detail_id LEFT JOIN tb_material_arrival_hd ah ON ah.material_arrival_id = ad.material_arrival_id AND ah.tenant_id = ad.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_customer_info c ON c.customer_id = rh.supplier_id AND c.tenant_id = rh.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_id = rh.receiver_id LEFT JOIN tb_login_account cla ON cla.login_code = rh.created_by AND cla.tenant_id = rh.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_user cu ON cu.login_id = cla.login_id AND cu.tenant_id = cla.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_material_info m ON m.material_id = rd.material_id AND m.tenant_id = rd.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_warehouse w ON w.warehouse_id = rd.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_group tcg ON tcg.tenant_id = rh.tenant_id AND tcg.group_code = 'PURCHASE_TAX_TYPE' LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_item tci ON tci.group_id = tcg.common_code_group_id AND tci.item_code = rh.tax_type WHERE rh.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT}
AND rh.use_at = 'Y'
AND rh.use_at = 'N'
AND (rh.receipt_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR c.customer_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR m.material_code ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR m.material_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR u.user_nm ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
AND rh.receipt_no ILIKE '%' || #{receiptNo} || '%'
AND c.customer_name ILIKE '%' || #{supplierKeyword} || '%'
AND (m.material_code ILIKE '%' || #{materialKeyword} || '%' OR m.material_name ILIKE '%' || #{materialKeyword} || '%')
AND oh.order_no ILIKE '%' || #{orderNo} || '%'
AND rd.arrival_no ILIKE '%' || #{arrivalNo} || '%'
AND rh.receipt_dt >= CAST(#{receiptDtFrom} AS date)
AND rh.receipt_dt <= CAST(#{receiptDtTo} AS date)
ORDER BY rh.receipt_dt DESC, rh.receipt_no DESC, rd.line_no
